name: game_data
notes: the game's data and save (0x09999C60 once loaded)

name: pad_held
notes: buttons held; the stick's direction as d-pad buttons in the high 16 bits

name: pad_pressed
notes: pressed this frame

name: pad_released
notes: released this frame

name: pad_repeat
notes: pressed this frame, or held long enough to repeat (menus move by it)

name: pad_stick_angle
notes: the stick's direction, 0x10000 a turn

name: pad_stick_tilt
notes: how far the stick is pushed, 0 to 127

name: quest
notes: the quest being played

name: game
notes: the game's main object

name: renderer
notes: draw lists (renderer_begin_frame)

name: video_player
notes: +0x14: non-zero while a video plays (the word at 0x08B59914)

name: sound
notes: the sound effect player (sound_play)

name: vblank_count
notes: counted by vblank_handler

name: video_playing
notes: the 60 fps code runs the game at 60 while this is 0

name: stage_manager
notes: method 0x28 returns the area's info (+0x3c: 3 cold, 4 hot)

name: players
notes: player_get(players, i): the hunter of player i

name: save_manager
notes: the save and its prompts (save_prompt_start)

name: sound_frame_count
notes: +1 a frame (sound_frame)

name: collision_world
notes: in game_sub's data; the world collision_sweep_sphere and collision_floor_height work on

name: fps60_stamina_every_other
notes: written by the 60 fps code: which call of hunter_add_stamina adds a small change

name: fps60_monster_count_every_other
notes: written by the 60 fps code: which call of a monster's countdown at 0x09ADD930 (game_task) counts
